comparators.FARE_note: stored official FARE c1 (fair_gini_dp, k100, gamma 0.3) with own LR heads, fit historically on OSF_DEFENSE_FIT and selected historically on INNER; not newly fitted (GUARD SEX is not exported); Z1 = same budget gamma 0
comparators.RAW_J: exact alias of RAW_PROJ (restored RAW_JOINT s0.3 E5, the competitively selected RAW-J); not refitted
comparators.eligibility: RAW_PROJ always required (incumbent). Every other B service is required iff point-feasible on all 12 FIT2 clauses vs N_EQ in both seeds (U0/Ucal-trained historical models are in-sample on FIT2, which favours their eligibility). Exact aliases of the primary are excluded. Ineligible comparators are reported descriptively.

design_disclosure: Designed after observing every predecessor result (including INNER outcomes of the two-recipient and minimal adapters). Exploratory development on repeatedly used Adult people; not confirmation.

endpoints.A: 24 INNER clauses of the primary vs U0 and Ucal (accuracy loss <= 0.010, NLL excess <= 0.010, summed Brier excess <= 0.005; both tasks, both seeds): point status and simultaneous status
endpoints.B: per required comparator c: pair benefit = mean_s[AUC_pair(c) - AUC_pair(P)] needs lower > 0.020; recipient excess = mean_s[AUC_r(P) - AUC_r(c)] needs upper <= 0.010 (r = income, occupation)
endpoints.C: J_TREE vs each of L_TREE, L_STRONG, S12_TREE, S21_TREE: pair benefit lower > 0 (improvement; >0.020 also reported), recipient excess upper <= 0.010, and J_TREE internally point-feasible; if J_TREE is not the primary its 24 INNER clauses join the family

bootstrap.unit: INNER duplicate groups, shared across models and both seeds

endpoints.family: K = 24 + 3 x (#required B comparators) + 12 (+24 if J_TREE != primary), frozen at SELECTION_LOCK; Student-t Bonferroni, alpha 0.05, df = INNER groups - 1
endpoints.status_rules: interval crossing a cap = UNRESOLVED preservation (not violation); whole benefit interval below margin = ESTABLISHED_SHORTFALL; fewer resolved clauses alone is not damage

fit2_proxy.definition: per candidate, seed and view: two-fold group cross-fit on FIT2 (fold = int(sha256("THP1|FIT2-proxy|"+unit))%2); readers LR_C1 and HGB_15x200 (validated fit_reader, model seed 2026101502) on the output wire [p, decision]; value = max over the two readers of the AUC of pooled out-of-fold scores against FIT2 SEX
fit2_proxy.fitting_rows: FIT2 fold A <-> B (never ATT/INNER, never training-critic loss)

forecasts.claim: selected teachers improve occupation FIT2 NLL over N_EQ by >= 0.010 (seed mean point)
at least one protected family has a point-feasible FIT2 nominee

nomination.T_REFIT: checkpoint matched to the J_TREE nominee (or fallback) epoch
nomination.candidates: per family: strengths {1,3,10} x checkpoints E{2,5,10,20} (sequential: P2E{2,5,10,20}); epoch 0 is the teacher alias and is excluded
nomination.diagnostic_privacy_checkpoint: DIAG_PRIV = J_TREE rho 10 E20, always attacked, descriptive only
nomination.fallback: if none feasible: minimum worst-seed max normalized clause violation (value/cap), same ties; attacked as ineligible diagnostic; never chosen by recovery
nomination.family_nominee: among point-feasible common (strength, checkpoint) candidates: lowest worst-seed coalition proxy; ties: lower summed FIT2 NLL (seeds x tasks), lower strength, earlier checkpoint
nomination.frozen_by: SELECTION_LOCK before any reader fit; no nomination from INNER
nomination.internal_point_feasible: all 12 FIT2 clauses vs N_EQ pass in both seeds
nomination.primary_service: among point-feasible family nominees of L_TREE, L_STRONG, J_TREE, S12_TREE, S21_TREE: lowest worst-seed coalition proxy; ties: summed FIT2 NLL, then family order J_TREE, L_TREE, L_STRONG, S12_TREE, S21_TREE. If none: NO_POINT_FEASIBLE_PROTECTED_NOMINEE

readers.controls: per seed and view on the T_TREE wire: group-shuffled SEX (OUT_HGB) and planted SEX bit (OUT_HGB); gates shuffled max(AUC,1-AUC) <= 0.60, planted >= 0.99; constant 0.5 exact
readers.descriptive: INNER envelope maximum over the slate
readers.equal_budget: every attacked service gets the same 21 direct fits per seed
readers.implementation: task_conditioned_representation.attacks.fit_reader (LR C=1 lbfgs; MLP 64x32 adam alpha 1e-4 300 iters; HGB 15 leaves 200 iters lr 0.05), FiniteScaler, model seed 2026101205+seed
readers.label_only_reference: FIT2 two-fold cross-fit SEX reader on true task labels (onehot income x occupation), diagnostic only
readers.pair: same seven on the concatenated features plus IGNORE_income / IGNORE_occupation aliases of all fourteen single-view readers (selection candidates, no extra fits)
readers.primary_reading: INNER AUC of the ATT-validation winner per service, seed and view
readers.training: ATT train groups with SEX; orientation and winner selection on ATT validation groups (fixed-orientation AUC); frozen before INNER labels

release_contract: each recipient: own full-precision probability vector + argmax decision only; pair = aligned concatenation (income then occupation). Nothing else: no leaf ids, raw inputs, scores, representations, teacher outputs, tokens, cells or flags.

resources.note: planning and admission began ~17:05Z; failed admission attempts V1/V2 are charged

roles.ATT: attacker-fit (train groups) and attacker-validation (validation groups, inherited SPLIT_SALT): fresh readers only
roles.FIT2: internal selection role (5211 = inherited FIT fold 2): task labels for Stage A headroom/prerequisite and Stage B utility nomination; FIT2 SEX (new export) for the predeclared recovery proxy and comparator eligibility only
roles.GUARD: fitting pool (2043): task labels only (no SEX export)
roles.INNER: repeatedly used development reporting role: features label-free until REPORTING_LOCK; labels opened once for the frozen report; never used to repair, nominate or select
roles.UPDATE: fitting pool (8180): task labels for every model; SEX for training critics only
roles.closed: historical assessment, HEAD_VALIDATION, CALIBRATION_HELDOUT (as fitting data), every reserved confirmation population

stage_a.early_stopping: fit 800 trees on the internal fit part with the internal 15% group fold as eval set; tree count = first argmin of the eval loss + 1; refit on the whole 10223-row pool with that count and the same random_seed; no early-stopping wait
stage_a.headroom: N_EQ minus teacher on FIT2: NLL, summed Brier, accuracy per task, per seed and seed mean, paired group bootstrap 95% percentile intervals; prospective practical target: occupation NLL improvement >= 0.010 nats (a miss is not proof of impossibility)
stage_a.prerequisite: selected teachers meet all 12 internal point clauses vs N_EQ on FIT2 (2 tasks x accuracy/NLL/Brier x 2 seeds; caps 0.010/0.010/0.005). If not met: stop protected fitting, attack T_TREE (predeclared diagnostic teacher) with fresh readers, label TASK_MODEL_PREREQUISITE_NOT_MET
stage_a.reported: accuracy, NLL, summed Brier, gain over constant, balanced accuracy, per-class recall, distinct decisions
stage_a.selection: per recipient the depth with the lowest internal-fold NLL summed over seeds 0 and 1 (tie: depth 4), shared across seeds; task performance only

stage_b.family: fixed teacher routing; f_r = f_teacher,r + sum_t delta[r,t,leaf_t]; delta = theta/T; zero start reproduces the teacher; income binary log-odds released as softmax(-d/2,d/2); occupation softmax(center(f))
stage_b.gradient_magnitude_logging: task, raw privacy and weighted privacy gradient norms per recipient every 20 steps
stage_b.privacy_movement_check: J_TREE rho 3: first 8 updates per seed re-solved without the privacy gradient (same AdamW state); transmitted 512-row probe outputs compared

recipe.calibration: FIT-only: at the exact teacher with warm critics, 16 fixed draws; lambda_J_r(rho) = rho * median||grad CE_r|| / median||grad joint_r||; lambda_L_r(rho) = rho * median||grad CE_r|| / median||grad local_r||
recipe.critic_input_normalization: inherited DiagonalReference refreshed at every epoch start on a fixed 256-row UPDATE reference sample
recipe.no_sweeps: no KL trust region, no decision-preservation constraint, no temperature/calibration, no critic-refresh or gradient controller
recipe.optimizer: AdamW per recipient, lr 0.01, betas (0.9, 0.999), eps 1e-8, decoupled weight decay 0.01 (shrink toward the teacher)
recipe.parametrization: delta[r,t,leaf] = theta_r[t,leaf]/T_r; theta_r = 0 at start (exact teacher)
recipe.privacy_pool: UPDATE rows with UPDATE SEX only (8180)
recipe.probe: fixed 512-row UPDATE probe (label-free SHA256 order) for privacy-movement counterfactuals
recipe.sequential_rule: first recipient trains 20 epochs while the other stays at its teacher; it is then frozen bitwise and the second trains 20 epochs with the joint objective restricted to it; critics continue
recipe.task_pool: UPDATE + GUARD (10223 rows); uniform minibatches with replacement-free epoch order

stage_b.stage_b_lock: after Stage A, a dated STAGE_B_LOCK binds the selected teachers, tree counts and exact leaf family before any protected fit
stage_b.zero_identity_tolerance: probabilities within 1e-12 (float64) and decisions identical on every admitted role
